summary: Most failures are placement errors where the model cuts and emits before disambiguating material (main verb, locatives, negation, or noun heads) arrives, leading to wrong agents, polarity flips, modifier-scope mistakes and pronoun misresolution. The prompt should bias low confidence (later ranks) for boundaries that fall after commas or early relative/adverbial markers and introduce explicit rules to hold short prepositional/temporal/adjectival fragments until their complements appear.
